title: Automated Generation of Challenging Multiple-Choice Questions for Vision Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether the language model used to generate multiple-choice distractors introduces a bias that favors itself or specific models by comparing the performance rankings of various Vision Language Models (VLMs) on questions generated by three different proprietary models (GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Gemini-1.5-Pro).
